newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portucel jumps on pulp rise then hits resistance.
newsitem.headline: Portucel jumps on pulp rise then hits resistance.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese pulp producer Portucel Industrial jumped over four percent after news of a pulp price to hit a high of 1,593 escudos but 1,600 seemed a dificult barrier to break, traders said.
The share was trading at 1,562 escudos at 1051 GMT, up 2.43 percent in trade of 240,000 shares. Earlier, the company announced a 20 ecu per tonne rise in pulp prices to 510 ecu.
"Portucel rose automatically after the announcement of the (pulp) price rise but not having the force to break resistance at 1,600 escudos, it corrected down," said one trader.
Unless the overall bourse rose sharply, the stock would probably not return to its earlier highs on Thursday, traders said.

"I believe that Portucel will eventually hit 1,600 escudos because of the information on the evolution of the sector is favourable but it will be difficult for it to do so today," added another trader.
"Above 1,580 escudos there people ready to take profit," added another trader.
